title: Frequency functional
statement: Given a binary subspace splitting of $H\subseteq bF_2^n$ and $gamma\in bF_2^d$, the associated frequency functional sends $z\in bF_2^n$ to the $ bF_2$ dot product of $gamma$ with the second coordinate of the inverse image of $z$ under the splitting isomorphism.
